summary: to_datetime converts a string into a Python datetime; subtracting two datetimes yields a timedelta whose seconds attribute excludes days.
questions: How do I calculate the difference between two dates in Ansible?
Why is the timedelta .seconds value smaller than expected?
How do I parse a date string into a datetime?

answer_card.title: to_datetime filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' | to_datetime }}` creates a Python `datetime`. Subtracting two datetimes gives a `timedelta`, which stores days, seconds and microseconds separately, so `.seconds` covers only the hours/minutes/seconds part. Use `.total_seconds()` for the full difference.
